yt_title: Zoho ERP Job Costing Explained: What It Covers (2026)
yt_desc:
Read the full guide: https://zudoworks.com/insights/zoho-erp-job-costing/

Does Zoho ERP do job costing? Not under that name. Its manufacturing module costs each manufacturing order instead: the components consumed, plus the cost of each operation. This 50-second explainer shows how that cost is built, where it stops, and what to look at if you are outside the market Zoho sells it in. Every fact was checked on Zoho's own pricing, feature and help pages on 16 November 2026.

Chapters
00:00 Does Zoho ERP do job costing?
00:04 Cost per manufacturing order
00:09 Cost templates: fixed and hourly lines
00:15 Job card time becomes labour cost
00:18 Cost Overview: estimated against actual
00:23 The catch: where it is sold, and Zoho One
00:31 What the other Zoho apps can cost
00:36 How ZMOS costs a job
00:42 The full guide

Key facts from the guide
- Turning on the manufacturing module gives Bill of Materials, Manufacturing Orders, Job Cards and Shopfloor.
- A cost template belongs to a work centre type. Each line has a cost name, a cost type of Fixed or Hourly, a rate and an account, and it is applied automatically while jobs are in progress.
- Each operation becomes a job card at a work centre. Time is recorded with a timer or by entering start and end times, and Zoho's help says labour cost is calculated from the job's duration.
- The July 2026 update added a Cost Overview: estimated cost on a bill of materials, and estimated against actual on a completed manufacturing order.
- Zoho's ERP pages sit on Zoho's regional site for one market, and the pricing page states it is not included in Zoho One. We found no edition for the United States, the United Kingdom, Australia or New Zealand.
- Zoho Inventory, Zoho Books and Zoho FSM each cost something (composite items, project profit, service jobs), but none costs a production job with material and shop labour together.
- ZMOS, our manufacturing software for small fabrication and machine shops, costs the job itself: material issued less returns, plus labour hours at the hourly rate entered on the job. Example from the sample workspace: $400.51 of material and 6.5 hours at $48 give a job total of $712.51.

Costing jobs on Zoho, or deciding whether you need something else? The full guide sets out each option: https://zudoworks.com/insights/zoho-erp-job-costing/

A question I get from shop owners who already run Zoho: "Can Zoho cost our jobs?"

The honest answer has two parts, and the second one surprises people.

I spent this week reading Zoho's own pricing, feature and help pages for Zoho ERP. There is no feature called job costing. What it has is a solid costing model built around the manufacturing order:

1. A cost template per work centre type, with fixed or hourly lines.
2. A bill of materials with components and operations in minutes.
3. Job cards that record time against each operation, which the hourly lines turn into labour cost.
4. Since the July 2026 update, a Cost Overview that puts estimated against actual on a completed order.

That answers the questions I would ask of any system. Can it record material at a real cost? Can it record time? Can it compare the total with what you expected?

Now the second part. Zoho publishes Zoho ERP for one market today, and its pricing page says it is not in Zoho One. I found no edition for the US, the UK, Australia or New Zealand.

So for most of the shops I talk to, the real choice is between Zoho Inventory or Books (which cost something, but not a production job), a custom Zoho Creator app, or a separate system. We make ZMOS for that last case, and it costs the job itself: material issued less returns, plus hours at your rate.

How does your shop cost its work today: per order, per job, or in a spreadsheet at month end?

Zoho ERP job costing: what it covers, and where it stops.

How Zoho ERP builds the cost of production:
01 Cost templates: fixed or hourly lines for each work centre type
02 Bill of materials: components, plus operations in minutes
03 Manufacturing orders: components consumed once the order is in progress
04 Job cards: operation time becomes labour cost
05 Cost Overview: estimated against actual on a completed order

Where it stops:
- The unit is the manufacturing order, not the customer job.
- Overhead is whatever lines you put in a template.
- It is not included in Zoho One, and we found no edition for the US, UK, Australia or New Zealand.

Our new guide also compares what Zoho Inventory, Zoho Books, Zoho FSM and Zoho Creator can cost, and how ZMOS costs a job. Checked on Zoho's own pages on 16 November 2026.

Which matters more to your shop: cost per order or cost per job?
